stem: Which diagnostic-test measure is the probability that a person with a positive test result truly has the disease?
explanation: Positive predictive value is the probability that disease is present given a positive test result. Sensitivity is the probability of a positive result when disease is present.
rationale: Positive predictive value is the probability that disease is present given a positive test result. Sensitivity is the probability of a positive result when disease is present.
